acceptance: A fresh database has no home; POST /api/home creates exactly one record with id home, and a second POST returns 409 HOME_EXISTS without mutating the stored home.
POST /api/equipment under the existing home returns 201 and round-trips through list and detail; blank names, invalid categories, and unknown homes return 422 or 404 and add no equipment row.

POST /api/plans enforces interval_days 1..3650 and mutual exclusion of last_completed_on and first_due_on; GET /api/tasks/due returns exact overdue, due, and upcoming sets at as_of and horizon_days boundaries, while invalid requests write nothing.

A completion with note inserts one history row and atomically sets due_on to max(previous last_completed_on, completed_on) plus interval_days; leap-day, month-end, year-end, future-date, oversize-note, and unknown-plan failures leave both plan and completions unchanged.

GET /api/history filters by home and equipment and returns documented fields in descending completion order; invalid filters write nothing; GET / is dependency-free accessible HTML and unknown routes or methods return documented JSON errors.
audience: A single homeowner keeping care records for their own home on a local machine, with no accounts, notifications, or multi-property operation.
name: Home Care Ledger
objective: Create the home and its equipment, define every-N-day care plans anchored to them, see exactly which tasks are due or overdue as of a date, record a completion with a note, advance the next due date from the actual completion date, and retrieve care history by home or equipment.
workflow: Start the local server against a disposable data directory; initialize the SQLite schema on first start.
Create the single home with POST /api/home, then add equipment records with POST /api/equipment anchored by home_id.
Create care plans with POST /api/plans using interval_days and an optional equipment anchor.
Query GET /api/tasks/due with an explicit as_of and horizon_days to see overdue, due, and upcoming work.
Record a completion and note with POST /api/plans/{id}/completions; the same transaction updates the plan next due date.
Read GET /api/plans/{id}/completions or GET /api/history filtered by home_id and equipment_id.
Use GET / for the basic accessible single-page UI; all actions remain available through the documented JSON API.
